INSERT INTO makeup_exam_student (session_id, student_id, score_entry_id, student_status) VALUES
(#{item.sessionId}, #{item.studentId}, #{item.scoreEntryId}, #{item.studentStatus})
mapper.select: SELECT mes.id, mes.student_id, s.name AS studentName, s.student_no AS studentNo, mes.score_entry_id, se.total_score AS originalScore, se.exam_status AS originalStatus, mes.makeup_score, mes.student_status, mes.notification_time FROM makeup_exam_student mes JOIN student s ON mes.student_id = s.id JOIN score_entry se ON mes.score_entry_id = se.id WHERE mes.session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY s.student_no ASC

SELECT se.id AS scoreEntryId, se.student_id, s.name AS studentName, s.student_no AS studentNo, se.total_score, se.exam_status, CASE WHEN se.exam_status = '缺考' THEN '缺考' WHEN se.exam_status = '缓考' THEN '缓考' WHEN se.total_score < 60 THEN '不及格' ELSE '其他' END AS reason FROM score_entry se JOIN student s ON se.student_id = s.id WHERE se.semester_id = #{semesterId} AND se.course_id = #{courseId} AND ( (se.total_score < 60 AND se.exam_status NOT IN ('补考通过', '缓考')) OR se.exam_status = '缺考' OR se.exam_status = '缓考' ) AND se.student_id NOT IN ( SELECT mes2.student_id FROM makeup_exam_student mes2 JOIN makeup_exam_session sess2 ON mes2.session_id = sess2.id WHERE sess2.course_id = se.course_id AND sess2.semester_id = se.semester_id AND sess2.status NOT IN ('已取消', '已结束') ) ORDER BY se.total_score ASC

SELECT sess.id AS sessionId, c.course_name, sess.exam_date, sess.exam_start_time, sess.exam_end_time, sess.location, sess.status AS sessionStatus, mes.student_status AS myStatus, mes.makeup_score, mes.notification_time FROM makeup_exam_student mes JOIN makeup_exam_session sess ON mes.session_id = sess.id JOIN course c ON sess.course_id = c.id WHERE mes.student_id = #{studentId} AND mes.student_status = #{status} ORDER BY sess.exam_date DESC, sess.exam_start_time ASC

SELECT sess.id AS sessionId, c.course_name, sess.exam_date, sess.exam_start_time, sess.exam_end_time, sess.location FROM makeup_exam_student mes JOIN makeup_exam_session sess ON mes.session_id = sess.id JOIN course c ON sess.course_id = c.id WHERE mes.student_id = #{studentId} AND sess.exam_date = #{examDate} AND sess.status NOT IN ('已取消', '已结束') AND (sess.exam_start_time < #{examEndTime} AND sess.exam_end_time > #{examStartTime})
